parameters.query:
-- Appointments whose time has passed that nobody ever marked.
-- Each one is either revenue never invoiced, or a front desk that has
-- stopped recording attendance. Both need chasing, for different reasons.
SELECT clinic_id,
       business_name,
       unmarked,
       revenue_at_risk_usd,
       oldest,
       avg_days_stale
FROM v_unmarked_appointments
WHERE unmarked > 0
ORDER BY revenue_at_risk_usd DESC;
